title: 第11章 每日任务
content_zh:
“发电机？你问那玩意儿干啥。”
现世，金陵大学食堂。
看着坐在餐桌对面真诚提问的岩风教授，汪海洋教授停下了手中的筷子。
对于这位岩教授，他了解并不多，只知道他是物理系，和自己年龄差不多，都是三十岁左右。
什么时候加的微信已经记不起来了，加过之后也从来没聊过天。自己是工程管理院的，和他在工作上本来也没什么交集。
但就在今天，他忽然收到了这位岩教授的邀请，在食堂约了顿午饭，说是有点事情想向他请教。
老实说，看到请教这两个字的时候，汪教授还以为是课题方面的事情，结果赴约之后，却没想到他问了这么个奇怪的问题。
话题在闲聊的氛围中继续。
岩风解释说道。
“……最近看了本小说，是末世题材。我想知道如果真的发生类似情况，幸存者该如何解决电力问题？”
“小说里的东西你较什么真，看作者怎么写不就完了，”汪海洋教授失笑着说道，“不过你这个问题到挺有意思，末世……那得具体看是哪种类型的末世，以及世界末日之后的第几天了。”
他也挺喜欢看小说的，不过看的都是修仙文，末世题材看得少。
话说他还真没想过，有一天会和大学里的同事，这么一本正经的讨论小说内容。
“设定上，是核战之后的两百年。”
“两百年？核战？”汪海洋教授愣了下，迟疑道，“那恐怕有点麻烦了。未经保护的电子设备会因核爆产生的电磁脉冲损坏，越是精密的仪器越难以幸存。”
“有办法吗？”岩风眉头紧锁道。
“有是有，比如一般小区物业或者餐馆都能找到备用的柴油发电机，这并不是什么很精密的设备，但两百年……估计早就被人搜刮过了吧。而且就算没被搜刮过，长时间没有维护，里面的零件八成也得老化了。而且燃料也是个问题，末世两百年……总不能指望加油站里还能找到汽油。”
汪海洋摸了摸下巴，思索片刻继续说道。
“不过也不是完全没有办法。”
“什么办法？”岩风立刻问。

“一般来说，每辆汽车上都有一台可回收的发电机，只要让转子旋转起来，就能产生稳定的12V直流电，修一下应该就能用。小规模发电，比如照明什么的，12V电压也足够了。如果能找到逆变器，把直流电转化成240V交流电也不是不可以……话说这个有必要记笔记吗？”
看着拿出小本本认真做笔记的岩风，汪海洋一脸懵逼。
看小说，至于这么认真吗？
推了下眼镜，岩风若无其事道。
“不用在意，您请继续。”
汪海洋：“……”
之前总听人说，物院的都是怪胎，他还觉得是刻板印象。
现在，他倒是有点儿信了。
404号避难所。
楚光在居民大厅席地而睡，睡到凌晨四点起床，一睁开眼便看见了系统弹出提示的弹窗。
【恭喜宿主，解锁成就“新手引导员”（玩家登录首日连续在线时长超过8小时）】
【奖励：+10奖励点】
还有这好事儿？
一觉睡醒又能抽盲盒了。
揉了揉惺忪睡眼，楚光
在价值1点奖励点的初级盲盒和10奖励点的中级盲盒之间犹豫了一下，最终楚光还是将“筹码”全部压在了中级盲盒的按钮上，同时在心中默默祈祷。
求求你了。
可千万别特么抽个止咳糖浆出来！
淡蓝色的光芒闪烁。
在楚光紧张视线的注视下，居民大厅墙壁一侧的合金门

【肌肉细胞强化注射剂。（小幅度永久提升肌肉强度，使用间隔24小时，多次使用效果递减）】
“永久提升肌肉强度？”
这玩意儿是好东西啊！
楚光没有犹豫，立刻撕开了外包装，将针帽摘下，然而意外的是，却没有看见针头。
话说这玩意儿怎么用？
迟疑了下，楚光将针管的头部贴在了胳膊上，按下了尾部疑似开关的按钮。胳膊就像被什么东西蛰了一下，再然后……
就没有然后了。
“这就结束了？”
楚光有点儿懵，挥了挥拳，也没感觉到自己的身体发生什么明显的变化。
难道是过期了？
毕竟是两百年前的东西……
出于谨慎，楚光还是给自己做了个体检。
而当他拿到检查结果之后，心中的困惑才总算是得到了回答。
ID：楚光
基因序列：管理者
等级：LV.5
——基本属性——
力量：9
敏捷：6
体质：7

感知：7
智力：6
“基因开发进度没变，力量和体质分别增加了1个点……嘶，有点东西！”
正常情况下，一名20岁的成年男性如果没有接受特殊训练，力量和体质通常是5个点，而5这个数字也是各项属性的基准值。
也就是说，这1个点的力量和体质，就相当于一名正常成年男性体能的20%。
楚光现在只差1点力量属性，就能拥有两倍于正常成年男性的力量了。
看着更新之后的属性面板，楚光心中琢磨着要不要做几个俯卧撑试一下，不过就在这时候，他忽然发现【管理者日志】中更新了新的任务。
好家伙。
昨天睡觉之前，还只剩一个未完成的支线来着，今天未完成的任务数直接变成了20+！
任务的种类也是五花八门。
从“狩猎一只异种”、“囤积5吨木材”、“囤积100L淡水”这种不太难的任务，到“修复疗养院外墙”、“修复疗养院二楼墙体”这种一看就很麻烦的任务一应俱全。
至于奖励，也是从最低1点到最高20点不等。
这些任务都有一个统一的标签——“日常”。
“日常是什么意思？每天都会刷新吗？”楚光忍不住吐槽了一句。
然而，并没有人理他。
避难所系统是不会说话的，小柒又在外面的疗养院站岗，整个避难所里就他自己。
楚光心里默默算了一下，如果能将这20个任务全部做完，一共能收获150个奖励点。
当然，这其中至少有四分之三的奖励点，不是那么好拿的，至少不是一天两天就能搞定的。
楚光陷入了思忖。
这些任务要是都由自己来做的话，肯定得累死。但如果交给玩家来做的话，自己似乎只需要付出几个“贡献点”。

想到这，他的思路瞬间清晰了。
电脑桌的抽屉里放着记号笔。
拿着笔，楚光二话不说坐电梯来到地表，在疗养院里搜寻一番之后，找到了一块还没被拾荒者们捡去烧了的塑料板。
掸去塑料板上的灰尘，楚光拿着记号笔，在上面画了两道，接着擦掉，满意地点了点头。
“不错。”
可擦可写。
就你了！
花了点时间，楚光从【管理者日志】中挑了几个玩家有希望完成的任务，写在了塑料板上。
【收集木材（要求：可充当建材）：每米1点贡献。】
【寻找储水容器（材质：塑料、金属。形状：桶状、壶状。要求：越大越好！）：1~10点贡献。】
【搜寻可回收利用废品：1~？点贡献点。】
【……】
“大功告成！”
看了一眼时间，现在是凌晨四点半，距离约定的上线时间还有一个半小时。
楚光没有闲着，回到避难所，0个。
现在是35人。
看来昨天在群里的讨论，还是起到了一定的引流效果，又有十只新鲜的小韭菜举了手。
不过，楚光寻思着，“牛马俱乐部”的用户潜力似乎也该被压榨到极限了。
毕竟这只是个百来人规模的游戏群而已，活跃用户一只手都能数得过来，没准这35人就已经是全部活人了。
“该考虑换一种推广方式了么。”

投放广告不太现实，废土OL的官网在国内是没有备案的，搞不好连服务器都不在地球上。
而且这里还存在着另一个问题。
一旦从更大的流量池引流，势必会涌入一大批“低素质用户”，也就是搞事情的人。
这些人也许只是出于好玩点了下yes，或者干脆是不小心点到的。
将这样的玩家招进来只会成为麻烦。
“必须提高预约的门槛才行……”
楚光心中思忖，默默记下了这件事儿。
等回头让小柒把官网再改一下，比如将预约选项从一级页面调整到二级页面，并且需要注册账号，以及填写电话号码和收货地址才能预约。
虽然这个避难所系统似乎并不需要玩家填写收货地址这种东西，但这么做至少可以筛掉一部分意志不坚定的玩家和“无效预约”。
话说如果有人开多台设备预约怎么办？
或者干脆就是机器人+虚拟机？
不过想了想，楚光便将这个问题扔掉了。
既然系统能将头盔精准无误的送到用户手上，那肯定有办法甄别预约者的身份。
自己操这么多心，未免有些杞人忧天。
“新的主线任务还没触发，应该是条件未满足。”
“日常任务暂且先不管，关键的是剩下的那个‘支线’——需要一台10KW功率的发电机。”
电力可是个大问题。
总不能避难所里是未来时代，地表上还在过原始社会的生活。
对于来自现代社会的楚光来说，没有电，和原始社会也没啥区别了。
“还是想想发电机的事儿该怎么解决吧！”
content_en:
"Generator? What does that thing do?"
Now, the cafeteria of Jinling University.
Looking at Professor Yanfeng who was sitting across the dining table and asking sincere questions, Professor Wang Haiyang stopped holding the chopsticks in his hand.
He didn't know much about Professor Yan. He only knew that he was from the Department of Physics and that he was about the same age as himself, both around thirty years old.
I can’t remember when I added WeChat, and I have never chatted with it since I added it. I am from the Engineering Management Institute, and I have no working relationship with him.
But just today, he suddenly received an invitation from Professor Yan and made an appointment for lunch in the cafeteria, saying that he wanted to ask him about something.
To be honest, when I saw the words "asking for advice", Professor Wang thought it was about the project. However, after attending the appointment, I didn't expect that he asked such a strange question.
The conversation continued in a chatty atmosphere.
Iwakaze explained.
"...I recently read a novel with an apocalyptic theme. I want to know if a similar situation really happens, how will the survivors solve the power problem?"
"Which of the things in the novel are true depends on how the author writes it," Professor Wang Haiyang said with a smile. "But your question is quite interesting. The end of the world... It depends on what type of end of the world it is and the number of days after the end of the world."
He also likes reading novels, but the ones he reads are all about immortality and less about apocalyptic themes.
Speaking of which, he never thought that one day he would have such a serious discussion about the content of the novel with his colleagues in the university.
"The setting is two hundred years after the nuclear war."
"Two hundred years? Nuclear war?" Professor Wang Haiyang was stunned for a moment and said hesitantly, "That might be a bit troublesome. Unprotected electronic equipment will be damaged by the electromagnetic pulse generated by the nuclear explosion. The more sophisticated the instrument, the harder it is to survive."
"Is there any way?" Yanfeng frowned.
"Yes, there are. For example, you can usually find backup diesel generators in residential properties or restaurants. This is not a very sophisticated equipment, but two hundred years ago... it has probably been raided by others. And even if it has not been raided, if it has not been maintained for a long time, 80% of the parts inside must have aged. And fuel is also a problem. Two hundred years after the end of the world... you can't expect to still find gasoline in the gas station."
Wang Haiyang touched his chin, thought for a moment and continued.
"But it's not completely impossible."
"What can I do?" Yanfeng asked immediately.
"Generally speaking, every car has a recyclable generator. As long as the rotor is rotated, it can produce stable 12V DC power. It should be able to be used after repair. For small-scale power generation, such as lighting, 12V voltage is enough. If you can find an inverter, it is not impossible to convert DC power into 240V AC power... Is it necessary to take notes on this?"
Looking at Yan Feng who took out a small notebook and took notes carefully, Wang Haiyang looked confused.
Are you so serious about reading novels?
Yanfeng pushed up his glasses and said as if nothing had happened.
"Don't worry, please continue."
Wang Haiyang: "..."
He had always heard people say that people in the academy were all freaks, and he thought it was a stereotype.
Now, he somewhat believes it.
Vault 404.
Chu Guang slept on the floor in the residents' hall and woke up at four in the morning. As soon as he opened his eyes, he saw a pop-up window prompting the system.
[Congratulations to the host for unlocking the achievement "Novice Guide" (the player has been online for more than 8 hours continuously on the first day of login)]
[Reward: +10 reward points]
Is there such a good thing?
When I wake up, I can draw the blind box again.
Rubbing his sleepy eyes, Chu Guang
After hesitating between the junior blind box worth 1 bonus point and the intermediate blind box worth 10 bonus points, Chu Guang finally pressed all his "chips" on the button of the intermediate blind box while praying silently in his heart.
Please.
But don't smoke one in particularCough syrup is out!
Light blue light flashed.
Under Chu Guang's nervous gaze, the alloy door on one side of the wall of the residents' hall
【Muscle cell strengthening injection. (Small and permanent increase in muscle strength, use interval of 24 hours, the effect will decrease after repeated use)]
"Permanently improve muscle strength?"
This thing is a good thing!
Chu Guang did not hesitate, and immediately tore open the outer packaging and took off the needle cap. However, to his surprise, he did not see the needle.
By the way, how do you use this thing?
After hesitating for a moment, Chu Guang put the head of the needle on his arm and pressed the button on the tail that seemed to be a switch. My arm felt like it was stung by something, and then...
There is no more.
"Is this the end?"
Chu Guang was a little dazed and punched, but he didn't feel any obvious changes in his body.
Has it expired?
After all, it was something from two hundred years ago...
Out of caution, Chu Guang still gave himself a physical examination.
And when he got the test results, his confusion was finally answered.
ID: Chu Guang
Gene Sequence: Manager
Level: LV.5
——Basic attributes——
Strength: 9
Agility: 6
Constitution: 7
Perception: 7
Intelligence: 6
"The genetic development progress has not changed, but the strength and physique have increased by 1 point each... Hey, there is something!"
Under normal circumstances, if a 20-year-old adult male does not receive special training, his strength and physique are usually 5 points, and the number 5 is also the baseline value of each attribute.
In other words, this 1 point of strength and physique is equivalent to 20% of the physical fitness of a normal adult male.
Chu Guang is now only 1 point away from the strength attribute and can have twice the strength of a normal adult male.
Looking at the updated attribute panel, Chu Guang was wondering if he should do some push-ups to try, but at this moment, he suddenly discovered that a new task had been updated in the [Administrator Log].
Good guy.
Before going to bed yesterday, there was only one unfinished branch left. Today, the number of unfinished tasks directly increased to 20+!
The types of tasks are also varied.
They range from not-so-difficult tasks such as "hunting a foreign species", "hoarding 5 tons of wood", and "hoarding 100L of fresh water" to tasks that are troublesome at first glance such as "repairing the exterior wall of the sanatorium" and "repairing the second floor wall of the sanatorium".
As for the rewards, they range from a minimum of 1 point to a maximum of 20 points.
These tasks all have a unified label - "daily".
"What does daily mean? Will it be refreshed every day?" Chu Guang couldn't help but complain.
However, no one paid any attention to him.
The shelter system cannot speak, and Xiaoqi is standing guard in the nursing home outside. He is the only one in the shelter.
Chu Guang silently calculated in his mind that if he could complete all 20 tasks, he would receive a total of 150 reward points.
Of course, at least three-quarters of the reward points are not so easy to obtain, at least they cannot be obtained in a day or two.
Chu Guang fell into thinking.
If you had to do all these tasks by yourself, you would definitely be exhausted. But if it is left to the players to do it, it seems that they only need to pay a few "contribution points".
Thinking of this, his thoughts suddenly became clear.
There are markers in the drawer of the computer desk.
Holding the pen, Chu Guang took the elevator to the surface without saying a word. After searching the sanatorium, he found a plastic board that had not been picked up and burned by the scavengers.
Dusting off the dust on the plastic board, Chu Guang took a marker and drew two lines on it, then wiped it off and nodded with satisfaction.
"Not bad."
Erasable and writable.
It’s you!
After spending some time, Chu Guang selected a few tasks from the [Administrator's Log] that the players were expected to complete and wrote them on the plastic board.
[Collect wood (requirement: can be used as building materials):1 point contribution per meter. 】
[Looking for water storage container (Material: plastic, metal. Shape: barrel, pot. Requirement: the bigger the better!): 1~10 contribution points. 】
[Search for recyclable waste: 1~? Points of contribution. 】
【……】
"Done!"
I glanced at the time and saw that it was now 4:30 in the morning, still an hour and a half before the agreed go-on time.
Chu Guang was not idle and returned to the shelter, 0.
Now there are 35 people.
It seems that yesterday's discussion in the group still had a certain drainage effect, and ten more fresh leeks raised their hands.
However, Chu Guang thought, it seemed that the user potential of the "Cow Horse Club" should be squeezed to the limit.
After all, this is just a game group with about a hundred people. The active users can be counted on one hand. Maybe these 35 people are all living people.
"Is it time to consider a different promotion method?"
It is not practical to place ads. The official website of Wasteland OL is not registered in China. Maybe the server is not even on the earth.
And there's another problem here.
Once traffic is diverted from a larger traffic pool, a large number of "low-quality users" will inevitably flood in, that is, people who cause trouble.
These people may have clicked yes just for fun, or they may have clicked it accidentally.
Recruiting players like this will only lead to trouble.
"The threshold for reservations must be raised..."
Chu Guang thought in his heart and silently wrote down this matter.
Later, let Xiaoqi make some changes to the official website, such as adjusting the reservation options from the first-level page to the second-level page, and it is necessary to register an account and fill in the phone number and delivery address to make an appointment.
Although this shelter system does not seem to require players to fill in a delivery address, doing so can at least screen out some unsteady players and "invalid reservations."
What if someone makes reservations for multiple devices?
Or simply robot + virtual machine?
But after thinking about it, Chu Guang threw away the question.
Since the system can accurately deliver the helmet to the user, there must be a way to identify the person who made the reservation.
It's a bit unfounded to worry about it so much.
"The new main mission hasn't been triggered yet. It should be because the conditions are not met."
"Ignoring the daily tasks for now, the key thing is the remaining 'branch line' - which requires a 10KW generator."
Electricity is a big problem.
It can't be that the shelter is in the future era, and primitive society is still living on the surface.
For Chu Guang, who comes from modern society, there is no difference from primitive society without electricity.
"Let's think about how to solve the problem of the generator!"
